text:
sam (ml eng): hi @people-ops — had a teletherapy session on 2026-02-10 with CalmMinds Therapy (Dr. Elise Park). I used telehealth from MA but my therapist is licensed in CA. Claim# 99887766 was denied as "out of network - provider not licensed in patient's state" and they billed me $120. i'm on Core Plus. member id ends 5566. anyone seen this licensing issue before?

nora (People Ops): sorry that happened. can you DM a pic of the EOB and the invoice? also, was this scheduled through our EAP or private pay/regular benefits?

sam (ml eng): it was regular benefits, not EAP. EOB says denial reason: "Provider not credentialed/licensed in patient's state on service date." Provider NPI on invoice is 3344556677 and they included telehealth modifier 95.

isabel (Benefits): thanks. quick background: carriers differ — some accept interstate telehealth via licensure compacts (PSYPACT, etc.) and some require active license in the member's state for reimbursement. Two paths: 1) confirm if provider is registered under an interstate compact that the carrier accepts; 2) ask provider to resubmit with supporting license docs and telehealth attestation.

lori (Health Plan Liaison): if they used the telehealth modifier (95) but the carrier requires POS=02 and an active state license, the claim can still deny. Ask the provider to include the license number, state of licensure, and indicate whether they are registered under PSYPACT (or other compact). We'll open a carrier inquiry referencing claim 99887766.

sam (ml eng): i checked CalmMinds site — Dr. Park lists CA license #PSY12345 and also lists PSYPACT on her profile. provider billing said they billed as CA-licensed.

isabel (Benefits): if provider is PSYPACT registered, many carriers will accept that as equivalent for telehealth across states — but carriers have different internal rules. Please ask Dr. Park to send her PSYPACT verification code or attestation and resubmit. Example provider ask we send:```service_date: 2026-02-10
claim_number: 99887766
patient_last4: 5566
procedure: 90834 (psychotherapy)
modifier: 95
place_of_service: 02
rendering_npi: 3344556677
license_state: CA
license_number: PSY12345
compact_registration: PSYPACT - verification code: 7X9-AB12
notes: Telehealth session provided via PSYPACT; please re-adjudicate under telehealth coverage policies.```

lori (Health Plan Liaison): opened carrier case TL-2026-789. Requested re-eval with PSYPACT verification attached and asked carrier to reprocess if accepted. Also requested adjudication notes and specific denial reason code.

therapy-billing: quick FYI for providers: when billing interstate teletherapy, include both POS=02 and modifier 95 (depending on carrier), attach compact verification, and include rendering provider license details in remittance note field to avoid auto-deny.

isabel (Benefits): if carrier refuses to accept PSYPACT for this claim, we can file an appeal attaching provider compact verification and a clinical necessity note if needed. Redwood policy: for out-of-pocket mental health charges caused by provider credentialing/clearinghouse errors, People Ops may consider an interim advance for eligible employees while appeal is pending — DM @nora to request.

hr-bot: Telehealth & interstate licensing FAQ: https://benefits.example.com/telehealth. Claims upload & HIPAA release: https://benefits.example.com/claims-portal.

nora (People Ops): @sam please DM the EOB and the provider PSYPACT code / profile link. If you want us to act on your behalf send the signed HIPAA release via the portal. @lori please keep us posted on carrier case TL-2026-789.

sam (ml eng): DM'ing EOB and PSYPACT screenshot now. thanks all for the clear next steps. :thumbsup:

lori (Health Plan Liaison): got the DM. i've attached the provider verification to the carrier case and requested expedited reprocessing. i'll update here when we hear back (carrier SLA ~ 7-10 business days).
